name: openpixo/game-key-image
title: Game key image
description: Make the game's key image first: one believable gameplay screen that becomes the style master. Then grow the style bible, the UI kit and the UI components from it, so every later image copies a real game screen.

description_i18n.en: Make the game's key image first: one believable gameplay screen that becomes the style master. Then grow the style bible, the UI kit and the UI components from it, so every later image copies a real game screen.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 先做游戏的效果图：一张像真实游戏画面的图，作为风格母版；再从它延展出风格圣经、UI 规范板和界面组件，让之后的每张图都照着真实的游戏画面做。

examples.title: Pick the game's look
examples.prompt: Make 3 key images of the confirmed game, each in a different look, and ask me to pick one as the style reference.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 为已确认的玩法做 3 张不同画风的效果图，让我挑一张作为画风参考。

examples.title: Match a game I like
examples.prompt: I want it to look like the screenshot I attached. Make a key image of our game in that look, with our own characters and places.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 我想要附图里那样的画面。用这种画风做一张我们游戏的效果图，角色和场景都用我们自己的。

examples.title: Key image for a new area
examples.prompt: Before making the swamp's art, make a key image of the swamp at night from the style reference, so the tiles and props have something to match.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 做沼泽的美术之前，先按画风参考图做一张沼泽夜晚的效果图，让瓦片和道具有东西可以对照。
